```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here()) # knit from project directory

library(tidyverse)
theme_set(ggthemes::theme_few())
```

# Load sample data

```{r}
df_flower <- read_csv("alldata/input/NPN/flower/Acer/2025.csv") |>
  filter(phenophase_description == "Open flowers")

df_leaf <- read_csv("alldata/input/NPN/leaf/Acer/2025.csv")
```

# Data cleaning

#Load functions

```{r}
source(here::here("code", "clean_data.R"))
source(here::here("code", "clean_by_resolving_conflict.R"))
source(here::here("code", "clean_by_leading_no.R"))
source(here::here("code", "clean_by_trailing_yes.R"))
source(here::here("code", "clean_by_window.R"))
```

#Use functions to clean flower and leaf data frames

```{r}
df_flower_clean <- df_flower |>
  clean_data(
    calculate_observation_option = "by_year",
    min_leading_no = 1,
    leading_window_days = 14,
    min_trailing_yes = 1,
    trailing_window_days = 14,
    max_doy = 213
  )

df_leaf_clean <- df_leaf |>
  clean_data(
    calculate_observation_option = "by_year",
    min_leading_no = 1,
    leading_window_days = 14,
    min_trailing_yes = 1,
    trailing_window_days = 14,
    max_doy = 213
  )
```

# Calculate onset day

Load function

```{r}
source(here::here("code", "calc_first_yes.R"))
```

Calculate flower onset date for both raw and cleaned data frames

```{r}
df_flower_onset <- df_flower |>
  calc_first_yes()

df_flower_onset_clean <- df_flower_clean |>
  calc_first_yes()

bind_rows(
  df_flower_onset |> mutate(group = "original"),
  df_flower_onset_clean |> mutate(group = "clean")
) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = group, y = day_of_first_yes)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter()
```

Calculate leaf onset for both raw and clean data frames

```{r}
df_leaf_onset <- df_leaf |>
  calc_first_yes()

df_leaf_onset_clean <- df_leaf_clean |>
  calc_first_yes()

bind_rows(
  df_leaf_onset |> mutate(group = "original"),
  df_leaf_onset_clean |> mutate(group = "clean")
) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = group, y = day_of_first_yes)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter()
```

# Compare all data cleaning functions separately

```{r}
df_flower_observation <- df_flower |>
  clean_data(
    calculate_observation_option = "by_year")

df_flower_no <- df_flower |>
  clean_data(
    min_leading_no = 1,
    leading_window_days = 14)

df_flower_yes <- df_flower |>
  clean_data(
    min_trailing_yes = 1,
    trailing_window_days = 14)

df_flower_max <- df_flower |>
  clean_data(
    max_doy = 213)

df_leaf_observation <- df_leaf |>
  clean_data(
    calculate_observation_option = "by_year")

df_leaf_no <- df_leaf |>
  clean_data(
    min_leading_no = 1,
    leading_window_days = 14)

df_leaf_yes <- df_leaf |>
  clean_data(
    min_trailing_yes = 1,
    trailing_window_days = 14)

df_leaf_max <- df_leaf |>
  clean_data(
    max_doy = 213)
```

Calculate the flower onset data for each of the applied cleaning
functions

```{r}
df_flower_onset <- df_flower |>
  calc_first_yes()

df_flower_onset_clean <- df_flower_clean |>
  calc_first_yes()

df_flower_onset_observation <- df_flower_observation |>
  calc_first_yes()

df_flower_onset_no <- df_flower_no |>
  calc_first_yes()

df_flower_onset_yes <- df_flower_yes |>
  calc_first_yes()

df_flower_onset_max <- df_flower_max |>
  calc_first_yes()

flower_master_onset <- bind_rows(
  df_flower_onset |> mutate(group = "original"),
  df_flower_onset_clean |> mutate(group = "clean"),
  df_flower_onset_observation |> mutate(group = "observation"),
  df_flower_onset_no |> mutate(group = "leading no"),
  df_flower_onset_yes |> mutate(group = "trailing yes"),
  df_flower_onset_max |> mutate(group = "window")
) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = group, y = day_of_first_yes)) +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = F) +
  geom_jitter(alpha =.1) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("original", "leading no", "trailing yes", "observation", "window", "clean")) +
  labs(x = "Data cleaning function", y = "Flower Onset Date")
flower_master_onset
```

Calculate the leaf onset data for each of the applied cleaning functions

```{r}
df_leaf_onset <- df_leaf |>
  calc_first_yes()

df_leaf_onset_clean <- df_leaf_clean |>
  calc_first_yes()

df_leaf_onset_observation <- df_leaf_observation |>
  calc_first_yes()

df_leaf_onset_no <- df_leaf_no |>
  calc_first_yes()

df_leaf_onset_yes <- df_leaf_yes |>
  calc_first_yes()

df_leaf_onset_max <- df_leaf_max |>
  calc_first_yes()

leaf_master_onset <- bind_rows(
  df_leaf_onset |> mutate(group = "original"),
  df_leaf_onset_clean |> mutate(group = "clean"),
  df_leaf_onset_observation |> mutate(group = "observation"),
  df_leaf_onset_no |> mutate(group = "leading no"),
  df_leaf_onset_yes |> mutate(group = "trailing yes"),
  df_leaf_onset_max |> mutate(group = "window")
) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = group, y = day_of_first_yes)) +
  geom_violin() +
  geom_jitter(alpha = .1) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("original", "leading no", "trailing yes", "observation", "window", "clean")) +
  labs(x = "Data cleaning function", y = "Leaf Onset Date")
leaf_master_onset

gridExtra::grid.arrange(leaf_master_onset, flower_master_onset, ncol = 1)
# add plot annotation
```

Visualize flower onset

Load US map

```{r}
us_map <- map_data("state")

flower_onset <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = us_map, 
               aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
               fill = "gray90", color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(data = df_flower_onset, 
             aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, color = day_of_first_yes),
             size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = c("#D1EFAF", "#BBD997", "#A8CB7C", "#98B76C", "#849F5B", "#6C804C", "#586E3B","#405724", "#2F4814", "#1F320B")) +
  coord_fixed(1.3, 
              xlim = c(-125, -65), 
              ylim = c(24, 50)) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = "Flower Onset", color = "Day of Year")
flower_onset

flower_onset_clean <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = us_map, 
               aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
               fill = "gray90", color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(data = df_flower_onset_clean, 
             aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, color = day_of_first_yes),
             size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = c("#D1EFAF", "#BBD997", "#A8CB7C", "#98B76C", "#849F5B", "#6C804C", "#586E3B","#405724", "#2F4814", "#1F320B")) +
  coord_fixed(1.3, 
              xlim = c(-125, -65), 
              ylim = c(24, 50)) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = "Flower Onset Clean", color = "Day of Year")
flower_onset_clean

gridExtra::grid.arrange(flower_onset, flower_onset_clean, ncol = 2)

```

# Calculate FLS

Combine data frames

```{r}

merged_flower_onset <- inner_join(df_flower_onset, df_flower_onset_clean, by = "individual_id")
merged_leaf_onset <- inner_join(df_leaf_onset, df_leaf_onset_clean, by = "individual_id")
merged_raw <- inner_join(df_flower_onset, df_leaf_onset, by = "individual_id")
merged_clean <- inner_join(df_flower_onset_clean, df_leaf_onset_clean, by = "individual_id")

```

```{r}
merged_raw$FLS <- (merged_raw$day_of_first_yes.x -merged_raw$day_of_first_yes.y)
merged_clean$FLS <- (merged_clean$day_of_first_yes.x -merged_clean$day_of_first_yes.y)

us_map <- map_data("state")

FLS_raw <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = us_map, 
               aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
               fill = "gray90", color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(data = merged_raw, 
             aes(x = longitude.x, y = latitude.x, color = FLS),
             size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = c("#D1EFAF", "#BBD997", "#A8CB7C", "#98B76C", "#849F5B", "#6C804C", "#586E3B","#405724", "#2F4814", "#1F320B")) +
  coord_fixed(1.3, 
              xlim = c(-125, -65), 
              ylim = c(24, 50)) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = "Flower Leaf Sequence", color = "Day of Year")
FLS_raw

FLS_clean <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = us_map, 
               aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
               fill = "gray90", color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(data = merged_clean, 
             aes(x = longitude.x, y = latitude.x, color = FLS),
             size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = c("#D1EFAF", "#BBD997", "#A8CB7C", "#98B76C", "#849F5B", "#6C804C", "#586E3B","#405724", "#2F4814", "#1F320B")) +
  coord_fixed(1.3, 
              xlim = c(-125, -65), 
              ylim = c(24, 50)) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = "Flower Leaf Sequence Clean", color = "Day of Year")
FLS_clean

gridExtra::grid.arrange(FLS_raw, FLS_clean, ncol = 2)

```

# Linear Regession with latitude

```{r}

regression_raw <- ggplot(merged_raw, aes(x = latitude.x, y = FLS)) +
 geom_point() +
 geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  labs(x = "Latitude", y = "Flower Leaf Sequence", title = "Raw Data Frame") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  ggpubr::stat_regline_equation(label.x = min(merged_raw$latitude.x), label.y = max(merged_raw$FLS)) +
  ggpubr::stat_cor(label.x = min(merged_raw$latitude.x), label.y = max(merged_raw$FLS) * 0.9)
regression_raw

regression_clean <- ggplot(merged_clean, aes(x = latitude.x, y = FLS)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  labs(x = "Latitude", y = "Flower Leaf Sequence", title = "Clean Data Frame") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
   ggpubr::stat_regline_equation(label.x = min(merged_clean$latitude.x), label.y = max(merged_clean$FLS)) +
  ggpubr::stat_cor(label.x = min(merged_clean$latitude.x), label.y = max(merged_clean$FLS) * 0.9)
regression_clean

gridExtra::grid.arrange(regression_raw, regression_clean, ncol = 2)
```
